ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows quadrilateral QRST, with R above, T below, Q on the left, and S on the right; the top angle ∠QRS is labeled 136°, and the bottom angle ∠QTS is labeled 68°; the upper two sides QR and RS have the same single tick mark, and the lower two sides QT and TS have the same double tick mark, indicating QR=RS and QT=TS. Reasoning: QRST is a kite, and the axis of symmetry is RT, so the corresponding angles on the two sides are equal, that is, ∠RQT=∠RST. The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°, therefore ∠RQT+∠RST=360°-136°-68°=156°. Because these two angles are equal, each angle is 156°÷2=78°. Therefore m∠RST=78°.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as quadrilateral QRST with R at the top, T at the bottom, Q left, S right. The image shows ∠QRS = 136° and ∠QTS = 68°, and the tick marks indicate QR = RS and QT = TS, so QRST is a kite with symmetry along RT. From the text, the target is m∠RST. Use the kite fact that the opposite angles between the unequal sides are congruent, so ∠RQT = ∠RST. Then apply the quadrilateral angle sum: ∠RQT + ∠RST = 360° - 136° - 68° = 156°. Since they are equal, each is 78°, so m∠RST = 78°.

method.method_draft: Read the image: QR = RS from the single tick marks, QT = TS from the double tick marks, ∠QRS = 136°, and ∠QTS = 68°. From the text, find ∠RST. Draw auxiliary diagonal QS, splitting the kite into triangles RQS and QTS. Triangle RQS is isosceles with QR = RS, so its base angles at Q and S are equal; each is (180° - 136°)/2 = 22°, giving ∠RSQ = 22°. Triangle QTS is isosceles with QT = TS, so its base angles at Q and S are equal; each is (180° - 68°)/2 = 56°, giving ∠QST = 56°. At S, ∠RST is the sum ∠RSQ + ∠QST = 22° + 56° = 78°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是四边形 QRST，顶点 R 在上方，T 在下方，Q 在左侧，S 在右侧。边 QR 和 RS 上各有一个相同的单刻痕，表示 QR = RS；边 QT 和 TS 上各有两个相同的刻痕，表示 QT = TS。图中标出 ∠QRS = 136°，∠QTS = 68°。要求 m∠RST。

推理：连接辅助对角线 QS，把风筝分成 △RQS 和 △QTS。因为 QR = RS，所以 △RQS 是等腰三角形，顶角 ∠QRS = 136°，两个底角相等，因此 ∠RSQ = (180° - 136°) / 2 = 22°。因为 QT = TS，所以 △QTS 是等腰三角形，顶角 ∠QTS = 68°，两个底角相等，因此 ∠QST = (180° - 68°) / 2 = 56°。在点 S 处，∠RST = ∠RSQ + ∠QST = 22° + 56° = 78°。
